name: Setup for Combined Wall+Ceiling Finish
intent: Single setup for the combined wall+ceiling finish pass. Unlike combined prime (pre-trim, nothing installed), finish happens when the house is built out — floors, fixtures, and trim are in place. Single combined pass needs floor protection, fixture covers, trim-edge masking exactly once — not once per substrate. The separate-mode finish scenarios would each fire protect/setup modules and duplicate work; this module consolidates.
doctrine: Consolidates setup tasks from MOD_PROTECT_FLOOR_INSPECT (floor), MOD_PROTECT_TRIM_MASKING (trim edges via 3 separate ps_keys — baseboard/door-casing/window-casing), and MOD_PROTECT_CEILING_FINISH (ceiling fixtures + window verification) into one setup pass. Each substrate's trim-edge masking still targets its own ps_key, so LF quantification is unchanged. Floor-inspection gating by floor_type preserved.
